raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread B. S. Ranga’s birth year as 1927 instead of 1917, despite WebSurfer providing sources showing 1917 (Wikipedia/IMDb). This led to an incorrect comparison (1927 vs 1922) and the wrong conclusion that Slim Carter’s director was born first, when in fact B. S. Ranga (1917) was earlier than Richard Bartlett (1922), making Thendral Veesum the correct film.
